title: Planned change: an A/R Detail bucket shows 100 lines, then more
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • One A/R bucket holds more than 100 lines (write its count down).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Read that bucket's count in brackets.
  4. Open that bucket.
  5. Count the lines shown before scrolling further.
  6. Scroll down to the end of the bucket.
  7. Count all its lines.
  8. Read the line after its last document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

  • Step 3 (unchanged from before the release): The count in brackets is the full number of lines, as before.

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, S4-R4, quoted: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”
  • Step 5 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): 100 lines first (production showed every line at once).
  • Step 7 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): After scrolling every line is there; the total equals the count in brackets.
  • Step 8 (unchanged from before the release): "Total for" the bucket, with its Amount and Open balance.
  • Related existing case: S4-07 C715360 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715360); DATA-05 C715454 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715454). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: Paging must not hide any receivable.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S4-R4. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:101-128; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:83; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingDetailReport.vue:130-153.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S4-R4, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-085). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
